blocks.content: The National Bank for Agriculture and Rural Development (NABARD) announced the final winners of the National Climate Stack Innovation Challenge on 10 August 2026. The challenge was organised with the Bill & Melinda Gates Foundation and Dalberg Advisors and used the Data in Climate Resilient Agriculture (DiCRA) framework.

items: NABARD was set up in 1982 and functions as India’s apex institution for agricultural and rural credit.
DiCRA stands for Data in Climate Resilient Agriculture.
Satellite data, artificial intelligence, and climate modelling are key technologies used in the winning solutions.
The challenge selected 3 winners from more than 150 applications.
